label: The LLM Gateway route patch configures provider llmgateway (display name LLM Gateway) with apiKeyEnv LLMGATEWAY_API_KEY, api openai-completions, baseURL https://api.llmgateway.io/v1, and compat thinkingFormat deepseek with supportsDeveloperRole false.

The LLM Gateway route patch declares model id deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 (name DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) with reasoning efforts off (empty), high and max, and pins agent-default-model to provider llmgateway, model deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017, reasoningEffort max.

The OpenCode Go route patch configures provider opencode-go (display name OpenCode Go) with apiKeyEnv OPENCODE_API_KEY, api openai-completions, baseURL https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1, and the same compat block; its header records the endpoint as unverified until a keyed run proves it.

The OpenCode Go route patch declares model id deepseek-v4.1-flash (name DeepSeek V4.1 Flash) with reasoning efforts off (empty), high and max, and pins agent-default-model to provider opencode-go, model deepseek-v4.1-flash, reasoningEffort max.

Route selection is model-driven: deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 selects route-llmgateway-deepseek.patch.yml while every other allowlisted model selects route-opencode-go-deepseek.patch.yml; the selected patch is passed to dsh --patch with the lineage patch and the reasoning effort is pinned per model. This lineage records model deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 at reasoningEffort max, so the LLM Gateway route is active here.

Independent documentation agrees with the patch text: .dsh/SYNC.md expects agent-default-model naming llmgateway + deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 for the LLM Gateway route and opencode-go + deepseek-v4.1-flash for the OpenCode Go route, while .dsh/README.md names LLMGATEWAY_API_KEY and OPENCODE_API_KEY as the two route credentials.
